title: Signs of even generalized binomial coefficients
statement: Let $0<s<1$. For every natural number $k$ with $1\le k$, the generalized binomial coefficient of order $2k$ satisfies $\binom{s}{2k}\le0$.
replaced: Let $0<s<1$. For every integer $k\ge1$, the generalized binomial coefficient satisfies $\binom{s}{2k}\le0$.
